From @pcogovph:

President @bongbongmarcos has ordered the immediate reconstruction of the fire-damaged building of San Francisco High School in Quezon City, along with the replacement of destroyed school equipment and materials used by students and teachers. The President also directed authorities to inspect the electrical systems of old school buildings to prevent similar incidents.

During his visit to the school, PBBM highlighted the swift response of the Bureau of Fire Protection, which was able to put out the fire within 30 minutes, as well as the quick action of the school administration in ensuring that classes could continue.
